SetupSystem.Launcher.Survey: Participate in PCL CE Hardware/Software Survey
SetupSystem.Launcher.SurveyHint:
This is a plan similar to Steam Hardware Survey, participating can help us better plan and develop, and we will publish the survey results irregularly.
If you choose to participate, we will collect the following information:
Launcher version and ID, Windows system version and architecture, installed physical memory size, NAT and IPv6 support status, whether you have used official PCL, HMCL or BakaXL

These data are not associated with you, and we will never sell data to third parties. Not participating will not affect your use of other functions.

AnnouncementWarning: If you choose this option, you will not be able to get relevant notifications even if serious problems occur in the future. For example, if a certain version of the game is found to have a serious bug, you may not be able to predict the consequences because you cannot get notifications. Generally, choosing 'Show announcements only for important notifications' will minimize disturbances. Unless you are making server modpacks or frequently manually update the launcher, it is strongly not recommended to choose this option!

ToolsGameLink.EulaDescription: Here are the relevant service documents and introductions used by the PCL CE Lobby
ToolsGameLink.PrivacyPolicyDesc: Learn how PCL CE handles your personal information
ToolsGameLink.NatayarkPolicy: Natayark Network User Agreement and Privacy Policy
ToolsGameLink.NatayarkPolicyDesc: View Natayark OpenID Terms of Service
ToolsGameLink.EulaContent:
Using the lobby function means you agree to the following terms:

I promise to strictly abide by the relevant laws and regulations of mainland China and will not use the lobby function for illegal purposes.
I promise to bear all risks associated with using the lobby function.
I am aware of and agree that PCL CE collects processed local identification codes, Natayark IDs, and other information and provides them to law enforcement agencies when necessary.
To protect the personal information of minors, I confirm that I am over 14 years old before using the online lobby.

In addition, you also need to agree to the PCL CE Lobby Privacy Policy and "Natayark OpenID Terms of Service".

SetupLaunch.Title: Launch Options
SetupLaunch.Indie.Tooltip:
When installing a new instance, automatically set the isolation options for the new instance based on this.
If you want to adjust the isolation strategy of an existing instance, please go to its instance settings.
SetupLaunch.Indie.Off.Tooltip:
All instances use the same profile, saves, Mods, resource packs, etc. are public.
If there are multiple instances with Mods installed, it may cause Mod conflicts.
SetupLaunch.Indie.Mod.Tooltip: Instances with Mods (e.g. Forge, Fabric) are independent of each other to avoid Mod conflicts, other instances (e.g. Vanilla) will not be isolated.
SetupLaunch.Indie.Snapshot.Tooltip: Isolate Minecraft snapshots, pre-releases, ancient versions, April Fools' versions from other instances
SetupLaunch.Indie.ModAndSnapshot: Isolate instances with Mods and non-release versions
SetupLaunch.Indie.All.Tooltip:
Saves, Mods, resource packs, etc. between different instances are not interoperable.
This will cause saves between different vanilla instances to not be shared, so it is generally not recommended.
SetupLaunch.WindowTitle.Tooltip:
Customize the title of the game window, leave blank to not change.
Supports the following replacement tags:
 · {user}: Player name
 · {login}: Player login method
 · {name}: Game instance name
 · {date}, {time}: Current system time
 · {version}: Game vanilla version number

SetupLaunch.ProcessPriority.Low: Low (Prioritize other programs running, but may cause game lag, suitable for AFK)

SetupUI.Blur.Title: Advanced Material
SetupUI.Blur.Tooltip:
Enabling this feature will implement blur effects in some transparent areas (e.g. cards).
Please note that this feature consumes a lot of GPU power and may cause lag!
SetupUI.Blur.Radius.Tooltip: Set the sampling radius of the blur effect, the larger the value, the stronger the blur effect.
SetupUI.Blur.Sampling.Tooltip:
Set the sampling rate of the blur effect, the larger the value, the more detailed the blur effect.
If the device performance is poor, try lowering this value to get better performance.
SetupUI.Blur.Type.Gaussian.Tooltip:
Use weighted mean sampling of Gaussian convolution algorithm for pixels in a larger range around each pixel, which is slower.
The blur quality is high and the details are handled carefully, recommended for devices with better performance.
SetupUI.Blur.Type.Box.Tooltip:
Use linear mean sampling for pixels in a smaller range around each pixel, which is faster but prone to color blocks.
This blur is easy to lose detail information, but has better performance, choose to use if device performance is poor.
SetupUI.Font.MOTD.Tooltip: Formatted code text font, used for server status information, etc.
SetupUI.Background.Title: Background Content
SetupUI.Background.Suit.Smart.Tooltip: Tile when content is small, adapt when large
SetupUI.Background.Suit.Fill.Tooltip: Stretch content and keep aspect ratio unchanged until it fills the entire window
SetupUI.Background.Suit.Stretch.Tooltip: Stretch content to exactly fill the entire window, likely to cause aspect ratio change
SetupUI.Background.Blur.Tooltip:
Strong blur will cause severe frame drops in the launcher, please use with caution.
It is not recommended to enable blur when making modpacks to ensure PCL runs smoothly on low-performance computers.

SetupGameLink.EasyTier.Title: EasyTier
SetupGameLink.Hint.Restart: After changing these settings, you need to restart the lobby for them to take effect.
SetupGameLink.Username.Hint:
PCL CE will try to use this username for lobby information display.
If left empty, the Natayark ID username will be used.

In some cases, the Natayark ID username may always be displayed instead of the name set here.
SetupGameLink.Protocol.TCP.Hint: Let EasyTier prefer TCP for communication. TCP usually brings better stability.
SetupGameLink.Protocol.UDP.Hint: Let EasyTier prefer UDP for communication. UDP usually brings lower communication latency.
SetupGameLink.LatencyFirst: Choose lowest latency path instead of shortest path
SetupGameLink.LatencyFirst.Hint:
When enabled, EasyTier will choose the path with the lowest latency during communication, instead of the path with the fewest routing hops.
Enabling this option may reduce latency in online games in some cases, but may increase packet loss rate.
SetupGameLink.PunchSym.Hint:
Let EasyTier try port guessing for symmetric NAT (Birthday Paradox).
This may improve the online experience, but may also cause some issues in some cases.
Generally, keep it enabled.
SetupGameLink.EnableIPv6.Hint: IPv6 is easier for P2P communication than IPv4 and can greatly improve the online experience. It is not recommended to turn it off unless there is a special reason.
SetupGameLink.CliOutput: Output Cli info in logs for debugging
SetupGameLink.CliOutput.Hint:
Output EasyTier Cli info in the launcher log every 30s to facilitate investigation by developers and community support.
This option is for debugging purposes only and is not recommended to be kept on all the time.
